title: feat(components): make `ui:text` honour the published `variant` and `align` enums
body:
Fixes #6942

The `ui:text` renderer now reads `TextSchema.variant` and `TextSchema.align`. The published enums do not move — `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` is untouched — the renderer catches up to them. Authority: the director-seat ruling in comment [5509027843](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/6942#issuecomment-5509027843) (summon #8, 2026-09-02, maintainer verbatim 「7189 A  其他同意」), option **B1, ENFORCE**. Clause-② no.

## The class map, and what it was modelled on

`ElementTextRenderer` already carries this concept for the `element:text` namespace: **`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`, `VARIANT_CLASS` and `ALIGN_CLASS` (lines 100-112), consumed by `ElementTextRenderer` at line 114**. The new map follows it as closely as the two vocabularies allow — three entries are its entries verbatim:

| `ui:text` value | class | element | provenance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `h1` | `text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h1` | the `element:text` heading idiom, one Tailwind step up |
| `h2` | `text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h2` | same idiom |
| `h3` | `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h3` | **verbatim** `element:text`'s `heading` |
| `h4` | `text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h4` | same idiom |
| `h5` | `text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h5` | same idiom (its `subheading` size, heading weight) |
| `h6` | `text-base font-semibold tracking-tight` | `h6` | same idiom |
| `body` | `text-sm text-foreground` | span | **verbatim** `element:text`'s `body` |
| `caption` | `text-xs text-muted-foreground` | span | **verbatim** `element:text`'s `caption` |
| `overline` | `text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground` | span | the only published value with no `element:text` sibling — conventional small-caps label treatment |

`align`: `left` / `center` / `right` / `justify` map to `block text-left` … `block text-justify`. Four values, not `ElementTextRenderer`'s three, because `TextSchema` publishes `justify` as well.

⛔ The two vocabularies are **not** reconciled here and `element:text` is not touched — that drift is the follow-up card the ruling reserves.

## Four judgement calls a reviewer should look at directly

1. **Absence is not `body`.** The Zod mirror declares `.default('body')`, which materialises on a *parsed* document; the renderer is handed the authored node. Synthesising the default here would put `text-sm text-foreground` on the ~690 corpus text nodes that never asked for a variant — a corpus-wide restyle, not the repair that was scoped. A node authoring neither key renders byte-identically to before.
2. **`block` is paired with every align class.** Three of the nine variants render an inline span, and `text-center` on an inline box centres nothing — declaring `align` and shipping it inert would re-enter this card's own failure mode one layer down. On the heading elements `block` is a no-op.
3. **`h1`-`h6` render the heading element they name.** A value that says `h1` and paints a span would deliver the size and withhold the semantics. `body` / `caption` / `overline` keep the span this renderer has always wrapped with, so nothing about inline usage changes for them.
4. **`inputs` declares `defaultValue: 'body'` for `variant`.** That restates the *published* default for a designer seeding a new node; it is not a claim about the absence path (1).

## The five catalog entries — per-entry decision

| entry | old value | decision | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `components-basic-text/paragraph` | `p` | → `body` (file kept) | shadcn `p` *is* body copy and `body` is the published spelling of exactly that. The only exact match of the five. |
| `components-basic-text/small` | `small` | → `caption`, renamed `caption.json` | shadcn `small` is the small de-emphasised step; `caption` is the published value for that role. Content re-authored "Caption text" so the tile names what it demonstrates. |
| `components-basic-text/lead` | `lead` | → `h4`, renamed `heading-4.json` | No published value means "large muted intro paragraph". `lead` is the larger of the two intermediate shadcn steps (`text-xl` against `large`'s `text-lg`), so it takes the higher remaining published step. |
| `components-basic-text/large` | `large` | → `h5`, renamed `heading-5.json` | shadcn `large` is `text-lg font-semibold` — the next step down, and what the published `h5` step renders here. |
| `components-basic-text/muted` | `muted` | **deleted** | `muted` names a COLOUR, not a typographic step, so no published value expresses what it meant. Re-spelling it `caption` would demonstrate the same rendering as the re-authored `small.json` — the duplicate this must not produce — and `components-basic-text/text-with-colors` already demonstrates `text-muted-foreground` on a text node (its third child is literally "Muted Text"). |

No published value is demonstrated twice. The category now authors `h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `h4`, `h5`, `body` and `caption` across seven tiles, plus `simple-text` (no variant) and `text-alignment` (three alignments, which now paint). **Two published values, `h6` and `overline`, are demonstrated by no catalog entry** — closing that would mean inventing two new entries rather than re-authoring one of the five, which is outside this card's fence. Both are covered by the renderer pin, and they are the obvious content for a follow-up if the seat wants full catalog coverage.

## Repairs beyond the five, each forced by the change and named here

- **`examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-feedback-loading/with-text.json`** — a **sixth** node in the same shadcn scale (`variant: "muted"`), sitting outside the category anyone was counting. Same defect class, one published value available for a spinner's small de-emphasised label (`caption`), no other claim on the file, same test suite. Repaired with the five and pinned by a corpus-wide sweep, so a seventh cannot arrive unnoticed.
- **`content/docs/components/basic/text.mdx`** — forced twice over: the page named the deleted and renamed ids (`getExample` throws on an unknown id, so a stale id is a build failure, not a cosmetic one), and its schema block taught a *fifth* vocabulary — `h1`-`h4`, `p`, `lead`, `large`, `small`, `muted` — that the validator refuses. Now the published nine.
- **`examples/schema-catalog/test/layout-dom-leak-5574.test.tsx`** — `NODE_CENSUS` for `text` moves `702 -> 701` rendered and `176 -> 162` no-element. Arithmetic, in the comment: one node fewer (`muted.json` deleted) and 13 nodes leaving the no-element class because a node that authors `variant` or `align` now needs an element to carry the class — the 7 variant-carrying `components-basic-text` entries, the 3 `text-alignment` children, the `with-text` label, and the `h3` headings in `basic-container` and `basic-stack`. The census moves in the SAFE direction: fewer phantom-clean nodes, more elements actually read.
- **`examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx`** — a comment whose example ("`components-basic-text/*` render a bare text node … 'Heading 1' is a direct child of the wrapper") is now false. Re-pointed at `simple-text`, which still takes that path. Comment only; the helper's logic is unchanged.

## Tests

New pins, both derive the vocabulary from the Zod mirror at runtime rather than restating it:

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/text-variant-align-6942.test.tsx` (57 tests) — one rendered element per published value; **the nine class strings asserted pairwise distinct**; the heading elements; `align` mapped for all four values and the four distinct; variant+align composition; authored `className` survives; the #6318 triage table now discriminating (`absent`, `body`, `h1` are three different renderings, where the finding measured them byte-identical); and the **not-C control** — the five shadcn spellings are still refused by `safeValidateSchema`, every published value validates, and an off-enum value is not quietly styled either.
- `examples/schema-catalog/test/text-variant-corpus-6942.test.tsx` (24 tests) — the corpus half: a sweep over **every** `text` node in all 432 catalog entries asserting each authored `variant`/`align` is a published value (named, not counted, on failure), the per-entry re-authoring, every `components-basic-text` entry validating, and the seven variant-carrying tiles rendering seven classes no sibling renders.

### Red-then-green ablation

Each mutation proved on disk before its run (anchored `grep -cF` of both the removed and the injected text, plus a blob hash differing from HEAD's); each restore proved **by state** — `git diff HEAD` empty and `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob — never by an exit code; `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths throughout. No rebuild leg: vitest aliases `@object-ui/components` to `packages/components/src` (`vitest.config.mts:415`) and the component pin imports `../renderers` relatively, so neither pin resolves through `dist`.

| leg | mutation | on-disk proof | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | the `variant` read replaced with `undefined` (the pre-card state) | removed-text count 0, injected 1, blob `2a6bcd0e` vs HEAD `1a66d9e7` | **23 failed** / 58 passed |
| B | the `align` read replaced with `undefined` | removed 0, injected 1, blob `1eaeee82` | **7 failed** / 74 passed — exactly the align pins and the corpus alignment tile |
| C | `h5`'s class set equal to `h4`'s | removed 0, injected 1, blob `6941a340` | **2 failed** / 79 passed — only the two distinctness pins, so distinctness is not vacuous |
| green | restored | `git diff HEAD` empty, blob `1a66d9e7` = HEAD | **81 passed** |

### The union, on `56b3edd15`

The tree these ran on is byte-identical to the commit (`git status --porcelain` empty; the ablation's green leg re-ran both pins after the commit).

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/` — **226 files, 2129 tests passed**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 examples/schema-catalog/` — **20 files, 1945 tests passed**
- `turbo run lint --filter=@object-ui/components --filter=@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` — 3 tasks successful, **0 errors** (950 pre-existing warnings, none in a file this PR adds or edits)
- `turbo run type-check` for both packages — 31 tasks successful. Verified it actually covers the new files: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists `text-variant-align-6942.test.tsx`, `text-variant-corpus-6942.test.tsx` and the edited `renderers/basic/text.tsx`.
- Gates: `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-snippets` (after the build its own preflight names — its first run reported PRECONDITION NOT MET, which is not a verdict), `regenerate-catalog-index.py --check` (index up to date, 432 entries), `check-changeset-presence` / `-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite` — all green.
- `pnpm check` (the CLI's own corpus scan): the "carries a registered ObjectUI component type but did not validate" bucket now lists **23** files and **no** `components-basic-text` or `components-feedback-loading` entry is among them. The `safe-validate-corpus-6318` docblock recorded 28 in that bucket when it was written; the five entries this PR re-authors are the difference.

Changeset: `@object-ui/components`, **patch**. Catalog entries and docs carry none.

## Handed on, not fixed here

- **#7444** (filed by this seat) — the same catalog category authors `color` on three text nodes and the docs page teaches it, while `TextSchema` declares no such key and nothing reads it. Different key, not published at all, so honouring it would be a vocabulary change rather than a renderer repair.
- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/check-validity-recogniser.test.ts:157` carries a comment describing its inline fixture as "copied verbatim from `…/components-basic-text/small.json`: real corpus content". The **assertion is unaffected** — `variant: 'small'` is still refused, deliberately — but that provenance is now historical rather than current. Left untouched: editing it would pull `packages/cli` into this PR's verification surface for a comment.

## Behaviour note, so it is not read as a regression

An external author who wrote `variant: 'h1'` and saw nothing will now see a heading. That is the declared behaviour arriving, as the ruling states. A node that never authored `variant` or `align` renders exactly as it did before.
